This page is the public home for the final projects created in IS310: Culture as Data. Each project connects an individual data essay to a collective set of principles and an openly documented group repository.

## Project Outputs

### Data Essays

Each student will write a public-facing data essay that makes an argument about culture as data. The essay brings together a custom-created dataset, an audit of existing cultural data, computational analysis, selected evidence, and reflection on the limits and ethics of the work.

### Group Principles

Each group will write collective principles for working responsibly with its area of cultural data. These principles synthesize lessons from the individual projects into practical guidance for future researchers.
